text: dsh-self-upgrade 是供 DSH web profile 使用的本体升级插件。它通过模型工具和设置页面板检查已安装版本与官方发布版本，并可查看版本历史和发布说明。手动升级会先备份，再通过 npm 安装；当 npm 尚无目标版本时可转为源码构建，随后校验安装结果并安排重启。自动更新可定期检查新版，并等待后台任务结束、会话日志静默后重启。适合需要从 DSH 内管理本体更新的用户；插件会访问 GitHub Releases 和 npm registry，不要求 API key。

dsh-self-upgrade checks official DSH releases and upgrades the web profile. It backs up data, installs via npm (with a source-build fallback), verifies the version and schedules a restart. Optional auto-updates wait for an idle session. It contacts GitHub and npm; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里查看本体有没有官方新版本。
能不能先备份再升级 DSH，并在安装完成后安排重启？
I want DSH to install official updates automatically and restart only when the session is idle.
dsh-self-upgrade 的功能「检查并升级 DSH」：查询已安装版本与官方发布版本，显示版本历史；用户可选择升级目标。升级前会备份，之后通过 npm 安装或在目标版本尚未发布到 npm 时使用源码构建，并校验安装结果。
dsh-self-upgrade 的功能「空闲后自动重启」：开启自动更新后定期检查官方版本；发现新版后安装，并检查后台任务及会话活动，空闲时安排重启。面板和模型工具可查看状态或取消挂起的重启。
dsh-self-upgrade 使用前须知：版本检查会访问 GitHub Releases 与 npm registry；安装更新时会从 npm 获取 DSH 包，必要时获取 GitHub 源码。代码未配置 API key。

dsh-self-upgrade

DeepSeek Harness 本体自升级插件：检测官方新版、自动备份、一键升级；自动更新等待系统空闲才重启，不打断进行中的会话。

Capabilities · Install · Auto-update · Security · 中文说明

dsh-self-upgrade README · Introduction：An in-place self-upgrade plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) agent. It detects new official versions from GitHub Releases, backs up your data, upgrades the globally installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package to a newer official version (npm install, or source build when npm lacks the tag), and restarts the service — with an idle-aware auto-update mode that never interrupts a running session. Downgrade/rollback is intentionally not supported.

dsh-self-upgrade README · Capabilities：| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh_upgrade_status` | Installed vs latest official version, upgrade job progress, pending restart state, log tail |
| `dsh_upgrade_run` | Upgrade / reinstall: backup → npm install (source build when npm lacks the tag) → verify → delayed restart |
| `dsh_upgrade_cancel_restart` | Cancel a pending scheduled restart or an idle-waiting auto restart |
| `dsh_upgrade_versions` | List official released versions with dates, current/newer markers and release notes |

dsh-self-upgrade README · Capabilities：| Panel（设置 → 插件 → DSH 本体升级） | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Version header | Installed → latest, status pill（已是最新 / 可升级 / 进行中 / 失败） |
| Actions | 检查更新 · 自动更新开关 · 一键升级 · 版本历史（浏览） · 立即重启 · 取消挂起重启 |
| Progress | 升级任务实时阶段进度条 |

dsh-self-upgrade README · Install：Official bundle plugin — one line, no build step, no install scripts:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raomaiping-hash/dsh-self-upgrade
```

Pin a version for reproducibility:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raomaiping-hash/dsh-self-upgrade#v1.1.1
```

Then restart the web profile (`sudo systemctl restart deepseek-harness` or your equivalent). A new “DSH 本体升级” tab appears under Settings → Plugins, and four `dsh_upgrade_*` tools become available to the agent.

dsh-self-upgrade README · How auto-update works：Manual upgrades keep explicit control: you choose the delay, default 5 seconds. Only versions newer than the installed one can be installed; rollback is not supported.

dsh-self-upgrade README · Security model：- The settings panel API answers **loopback Host only** (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `::1`) — it can trigger installs and service restarts, so it is never exposed through reverse proxies or tunnels. Remote management goes through the logged-in agent session (`dsh_upgrade_*` tools).
- Privileged steps use passwordless `sudo` for exactly three commands: the backup script, `npm install -g`, and a transient `systemd-run` unit that restarts the service. Nothing else is elevated.
- No telemetry; external calls are limited to GitHub Releases, the npm registry and the local systemd.

dsh-self-upgrade README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness web profile
- Linux with systemd, deployed as a service user whose `sudo -n` may run the three whitelisted commands above
- `git` on PATH for version probes

dsh-self-upgrade README · Test：```sh
node tests/contract.mjs
```

Validates the npm/bundle contract (manifest fields, entry exports, client registration marker, patch row) and scans published files for embedded secrets.
dsh-self-upgrade README · 插件管理：已装插件用 plugin-registry 的**薄控制台**管理（浏览器面板）：管理 profile 插件安装态（bundle 层栈 + insert 行 + 启停），无需手改配置。
